def _record_pixnav_navigation_outcome(
        self,
        result: LocalPolicyResult,
        *,
        moved_distance_m: float | None = None,
        progress: bool | None = None,
        no_progress: bool | None = None,
        apply_pose: Pose2D | None = None,
        apply_stamp_ns: int | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        runtime = getattr(self, "runtime", None)
        task = getattr(runtime, "task", None)
        if runtime is None or task is None:
            return False
        terminal_pose = apply_pose
        terminal_stamp_ns = apply_stamp_ns
        if terminal_pose is None:
            pose_message = _policy_result_pose_message(self, result)
            if pose_message is not None:
                terminal_pose = _pose2d_from_stamped_pose(pose_message)
                terminal_stamp_ns = _time_to_ns(pose_message.header.stamp)
        if terminal_stamp_ns is None or terminal_stamp_ns <= 0:
            terminal_stamp_ns = int(result.result_stamp_ns)
        translation_m = moved_distance_m
        if translation_m is None:
            translation_m = 0.0
            if terminal_pose is not None:
                observation_pose = runtime.navigation_attempt_observation_pose(
                    result.decision_id
                )
                translation_m = math.hypot(
                    terminal_pose.x - observation_pose.x,
                    terminal_pose.y - observation_pose.y,
                )
        evidence = getattr(self, "robot_pixnav_progress", None)
        if evidence is not None:
            translation_m = evidence.summary(task.episode_id, result)["translation_m"]
            if translation_m < float(getattr(self, "reference_min_go_progress_m", 0.05)):
                progress, no_progress = False, True
        classified_no_progress = (
            translation_m
            < float(getattr(self, "reference_min_go_progress_m", 0.05))
            if no_progress is None
            else bool(no_progress)
        )
        classified_progress = (
            not classified_no_progress if progress is None else bool(progress)
        )
        terminal_outcome = pixnav_success_outcome(
            result,
            episode_id=task.episode_id,
            moved_distance_m=translation_m,
            progress=classified_progress,
            no_progress=classified_no_progress,
        )
        if terminal_outcome is None:
            return False
        memory_changed = runtime.record_navigation_outcome(
            terminal_outcome,
            apply_pose=terminal_pose,
            apply_stamp_ns=terminal_stamp_ns,
            recovery_ttl_ns=self.recovery_plan_ttl_ns,
        )
        self._write_async_trace(
            "pixnav_navigation_outcome_recorded",
            {
                "decision_id": terminal_outcome.decision_id,
                "terminal_reason": terminal_outcome.termination_reason,
                "collision_count": terminal_outcome.collision_count,
                "moved_distance_m": terminal_outcome.moved_distance_m,
                "progress": terminal_outcome.progress,
                "no_progress": terminal_outcome.no_progress,
                "supervisor_mode": runtime.session.supervisor_mode,
            },
            filename="recovery_plan_trace.jsonl",
        )
        if memory_changed:
            self._publish_memory_debug(terminal_outcome.decision_id)
        if classified_no_progress:
            VlmMockNode._queue_no_progress_observation_recovery(
                self,
                decision_id=terminal_outcome.decision_id,
                memory_changed=bool(memory_changed),
            )
            self._dispatch_supervisor_escape_intent(
                outcome_stamp_ns=terminal_stamp_ns,
            )
        else:
            self.reference_async_no_progress_sweep_count = 0
            self.reference_same_pose_observation_escape_rotate_count = 0
            self.reference_same_pose_observation_no_progress_context = False
            self.reference_same_pose_pointnav_full_sweep_count = 0
            self._queue_task_terminal_observation_from_outcome(
                terminal_outcome,
                outcome_stamp_ns=terminal_stamp_ns,
            )
        return True
